summary: Applied Digital Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its cloud business divestiture via a Contribution and Exchange Agreement dated February 15, 2026 with Ekso Bionics Holdings, Inc. Applied Digital contributed 100% of cloud subsidiary shares (1,200 shares) in exchange for 138,216,820 newly issued Ekso shares, giving Applied Digital ~97% ownership. Ekso changed its name to ChronoScale Corporation (symbol: CHRN). A concurrent private placement: Applied Digital purchased 1,311,407 Ekso shares at $12.01/share. No premium, board recommendation, or advisor named; the mechanics were a stock-for-stock exchange with a controlling interest. What to watch: dilution impact on deconsolidation accounting and alignment of interests post-close.
